title: Rank-zero bundle integration and the cone mate preserve the coefficient unit
statement: Let finite A be annihilated by N>0, let S be Noetherian with N invertible on S, and let g:V→S and a closed section s satisfy s≫g=id and Geometry 0 g s. Suppose the normal projection is etale and separated. For graph-normalized C and the specified Cartesian cone-to-rank-zero-conormal-bundle square sq, bundleSectionAdjoint followed by normalSectionMap(sq) and the normal-section coordinates is zeroLineIso.hom. This assertion contains neither a Rees family isomorphism nor specialization. The maps are those of [lem-trf-finite-ring-section-deformation, def-pur-finite-smooth-canonical-maps, def-pur-finite-smooth-adjunction-data, def-pur-finite-smooth-comparison-coordinates].

proof.text: Use bundleOrientation_purity and the coefficient-unit projection inverse to identify the inverse bundleSectionAdjoint with the affine-normalized bundle section orientation. Apply its existing rank-zero orientation theorem. The rank-zero bundle section coordinate calculation identifies the resulting identity-adjunction comparison with the graph-normalized section coordinates.

The given cone/bundle isomorphism preserves the zero section by its specification theorems. Apply section-coordinate base change to this square. The inverse identity-pullback constraint in normalSectionMap cancels its unit comparison, so this mate carries normal coordinates to bundle coordinates. Substitute the rank-zero orientation identity and cancel bundleSectionAdjoint against its inverse. The remaining single-unit identification is exactly zeroLineIso at d=0.

theorem finiteRankZeroNormalIntegration_coordinates
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    {V S : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian S]
    (g : V ⟶ S) (s : S ⟶ V) [IsClosedImmersion s] (hs : s ≫ g = 𝟙 S)
    [FiniteRingSectionDeformation.Geometry 0 g s]
    [Etale (Scheme.Hom.normalConeProj g s)] [IsSeparated (Scheme.Hom.normalConeProj g s)]
    (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤)))
    (C : FiniteSmoothCompactSupportComparisons A)
    (hC : FiniteSmoothComparisonNormalized A C)
    (sq : IsPullback
      (reesConeComparison s ≪≫ FiniteRingSectionDeformation.coneBundleIso 0 g s).hom
      (Scheme.Hom.normalConeProj g s)
      (VectorBundleZeroSection.π S 0 (ConormalGradedAlgebra.piece s 1)) (𝟙 S)) :
    FiniteRingSectionDeformation.bundleSectionAdjoint N hN A hA S hS 0
        (ConormalGradedAlgebra.piece s 1) ≫ normalSectionMap A 0 g s hs sq ≫
        (finiteSmoothSectionCoordinates A C (Scheme.Hom.normalConeProj g s)
          (Scheme.Hom.normalConeZeroSection s)).hom =
      (zeroLineIso A N hA S 0 rfl).hom
